from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
from numpy import *

T = array([int] * 20)


def Saisie():
    b = False
    while not b:
        N = int(input("Donner n: "))
        b = 5 <= N <= 20
    return N


def Remplir(N):
    for i in range(N):
        T[i] = int(input("T[" + str(i) + "]="))


def Appartenance(p, T, N):
    if p.isnumeric():
        a = int(p)
        ok = False
        i = -1
        while i < N and ok == False:
            i += 1
            ok = T[i] == a
        if ok == True:
            f.t2.setText("appartient")
        else:
            f.t2.setText("n'appartient pas")
    else:
        f.t2.setText("INPUT ERROR")


N = Saisie()
Remplir(N)
app = QApplication([])
f = loadUi('saisie_tab_et_entier.ui')
f.show()
f.pb.clicked.connect(lambda: Appartenance(f.t1.text(), T, N))
app.exec_()
